objective: Bring the Heart of Hakkar to Molthor on Yojamba Isle.

description: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within.  Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
progress: <name>, the reek of an evil soul surrounds you.  Have you been cursed by the Soulflayer?
completion: Ah, the Heart of Hakkar.  So the Soulflayer has been slain!  Our world is saved!
<name>, your service to us cannot be overstated.  You truly are a hero of this realm!
